info.prompt: A cyber-alchemist's workbench where dice of frozen {neon vitae|black mercury} roll across a neural lattice etched into the table—each territory claimed sprouts a flagpole of {spinal wire|liquid gold}, flags blooming into player-color sigils that drip onto the board, connecting three adjacent tiles into a Domain glow so bright it casts the alchemist's bone-mask in stark relief, their fingers (gloved in {stolen skin|circuit tape}) toggling the Bit Crusher decoration to shatter the ambient harps into glitching arpeggios.
